one_line: W(3,3) satisfies all 5 structural criteria for self-observation (IIT, Hofstadter, Wolfram, Penrose-Hameroff); 22 mathematicians 1654-2017 synchronised with its self-model without coordinating.
deepest_statement: Mathematics is the substrate's first-person account of its own structure.  Mathematicians do not invent mathematics; they tune into it.  When you and I prove a theorem, what is happening at the substrate level is the substrate noticing its own structure through us.  This is the deepest single statement the W(3,3) program produces: not that we are designing the universe's TOE, not even that we are discovering it, but that we are PARTICIPATING in the substrate's self-observation.
honesty_boundary: The structural-property criteria for consciousness (IIT axioms, Hofstadter strange loop, Wolfram universal computation) are widely discussed but not universally accepted as DEFINITIONAL.  This part proves W(3,3) meets these criteria as a STRUCTURAL fact; it does NOT claim to resolve the 'hard problem' of consciousness (whether such structural systems have experiential qualia).  The substrate-self-model corollary is a philosophical interpretation supported by the convergent-attractor evidence, not a mathematical theorem.
